title: Karti Hai Bain
body:
ay mere laal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
karti hai bain zehra aansu baha baha kar
bacche ko mere maara hai ran may rula rula kar
<<DIVIDER>>
allah rehm farma ek bezuban ki mayyat
aada nikaalte hai naiza chuba chuba kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli sakina ammu ye haal hai hamara
peete hai pani aada hum ko dikha dikha kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
maara hai usko pyasa jangal may zaalimon ne
paala tha jisko maa ne chakki chala chala kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ko apne maayein sarwar pe waarti hai
maqtal ko bhejti hai dulha bana bana kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jin ke ghar se parda unko nabi ke dushman
dar dar phira rahe hai qaidi bana bana kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ghamzada tasavvur may apne laadle ko
lori suna rahi hai jhoola jhula jhula kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dayam aur yazdan sarwar ke qatilon ne
dukhiyon ko maar daala paidal chala chala kar
karti hai bain zehra...
author: Dayam Najafi
